description: Angular component for managing notification settings, including form handling, user preferences, and delivery methods.

classes.name: NotificationSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for notification settings, extending PageComponent and implementing HasConfirmForm.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and builds the notification settings form.

methods.name: buildNotificationSettingsForm
methods.description: Creates the reactive form group for notification preferences.

methods.name: patchNotificationSettings
methods.description: Populates the form with user notification settings.

methods.name: prepareNotificationSettings
methods.description: Prepares and normalizes notification preferences data for form binding.

methods.name: resetSettings
methods.description: Resets all notification settings to default after user confirmation.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Checks if all notification preferences or delivery methods are enabled.

methods.name: getSomeChecked
methods.description: Checks if some notification preferences are enabled.

methods.name: getIndeterminate
methods.description: Determines if the checkbox state is indeterminate based on enabled preferences.

methods.name: changeInstanceTypeCheckBox
methods.description: Toggles all notification preferences or delivery methods based on user interaction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current notification settings to the server.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation before navigation away.
